groups.title: body and health
groups.note: Flesh on the left, and what goes wrong with it.

chars.story: The flesh that carries you forward and back: the leg.
The covering over the flesh: skin.
The organ said to give you nerve: the gall, so courage.
chars.note: 胆 stands for 膽. Also the gall bladder.

chars.story: The vital flesh inside the body: the organs.
chars.note: Also 'dirty': 弄脏 'make dirty'. 脏 stands for 臟 and 髒.

chars.story: The clear round part of the eye: the eyeball.
Flesh that has piled up: fat.
A sickness that strikes like a weapon, everywhere at once: epidemic.

chars.parts: 乃 curled body (shape) + 子 child
chars.story: A body curled round a child: pregnant.

groups.title: hand 扌 and person 亻

chars.story: A hand with a sharp hook sticks it in and ties.
A hand pulls a thing straight and upright: straight, and in speech 'quite'.
chars.note: Before an adjective it means 'quite': 挺好.

chars.story: A person stretching their limbs out: stretch.
A person tilts the head back: look up.

groups.title: silk 纟
groups.note: Thread and what is done with it.

chars.story: Thread wound round and round: go around.
Colored threads meeting on cloth: a picture is drawn.
Threads running one after another lengthwise: vertical.

groups.title: horses and beasts
groups.note: Animals that move you or frighten you.

chars.story: Horses drive everything out of an area: expel.
A horse running fast, a vehicle on its way: speed along.
A horse pestered by fleas stirs everything up: disrupt.

chars.parts: 虍 tiger head + 儿 legs
chars.story: A tiger's striped head set on legs.

chars.parts: 丷 horns + 田 field + 口 mouth
chars.story: Horns above a field and a mouth: a beast out grazing.
A shout that makes you drop down: frighten.

chars.parts: 口 mouth + 口 mouth + 马 horse
chars.story: Two mouths shouting at a horse: scold.
Water seeping in through the gate: moist.
chars.note: 润 stands for 潤. 利润 'profit' is the commonest word.

chars.story: Water over bone: it slips.
Water standing still: a pond.
Water drawn along a hooked cut in the ground: a gutter.
chars.note: 沟 stands for 溝. In 沟通 it means 'link up'.

chars.story: Fire catching hold: ignite.
A bird held over a fire: scorched.
Wine gone off: sour.

chars.parts: 酉 wine jar + 告 tell (sound)
chars.story: Wine that bites the throat: harsh, ruthless.

groups.title: measures
groups.note: Units you will see in numbers.

chars.parts: - a hand-span laid down across a length
chars.story: A hand-span laid out along a length: a ruler.
A mouth calling out the weight of a stockpile: tons.
chars.note: 吨 stands for 噸. A loanword.

chars.story: A grain's worth of time, a little bit: a second.
The sun at its hour of rising: morning.
Grain turned fire-red at harvest: autumn.
chars.note: 秋 stands for 鞦 in 秋千 'swing'.

chars.story: Meat kept from days gone by: cured.
chars.note: 腊月 is the twelfth lunar month. 古希腊 'ancient Greece'. 腊 stands for 臘.

chars.story: Little round heads of fruit: grains, beads.
chars.note: Counts small round things: 一颗心 one heart. 颗 stands for 顆.

chars.story: Handing out to each head in turn: issue.
Take a little and try it: taste.
A person made to taste what they owe, and pay it back: repay.
A woman with a lithe figure: graceful.
chars.note: Mostly a sound in women's names: 安娜 Anna.

chars.story: Ears pricked up toward the town: a cheer.
chars.note: Mostly sound: 耶稣 Jesus. In chat: 好耶 'yay'.

chars.story: A steady tap, firm and kindly: kindhearted.
chars.note: Mostly a sound: 伦敦 London.

chars.parts: 禾 grain + 白 white + 彡 hairs
chars.story: Ripe grain bowing still in the air: reverent.
chars.note: A surname, and a sound in foreign names.

chars.story: Music played at the feast for a victory: triumphal.
chars.note: 凯 stands for 凱. Often a sound in names.

chars.story: A heart stuck fast on an old wrong: hate.
A heart in a dismal state: miserable.
Not holding it in mind: it slips, then happens all of a sudden.
The heart that tells every detail apart: know well.

chars.parts: - a cross-bar over a sharp needle
chars.story: A needle-sharp tool: sharp, bitter, pungent, laborious.
chars.note: In 辛苦 it means toil, hardship.

chars.story: Two sharp parties with words in between: debate.
A tongue-lashing turned to words of farewell: resign, decline.
Walking the way you came: return to.

chars.parts: 辶 walk + 弟 younger brother (sound)
chars.story: Walking something over to someone: deliver.
Steps over to the far side: that one there.
chars.note: Literary 'that'; modern speech says 那. Mostly in 彼此 'each other'.

chars.story: A foot pressed down on a promise to carry it out: fulfill.
Cart wheels following the same line: a track.
Carts lined up in rows, one generation after another.

groups.title: knife 刂 and clothes 衣
groups.note: A blade on the right, cloth below.

chars.story: Cut into even portions: a dose.
chars.note: 剂 stands for 劑. A medicine mix.

chars.parts: 尸 + 巾 cloth + 刂 knife
chars.story: A cloth drawn like a blade across a surface: brush.
A knife with an edge on both sides: a sword.
Clothes ripped into strips: split.
Cloth sewn into a bag: a bag.

groups.title: plants and wood 艹 木

chars.story: The little stalk holding fruit to the branch: the stem.
chars.note: Mostly a sound: 罗曼蒂克 romantic.

chars.story: A heavy-set overseer standing over the field hands: director.
A tree that blooms every year in the snow: plum.

chars.parts: 氵 water + 刃 blade (shape) + 木 tree
chars.story: A tree trunk laid across water: a beam, a bridge.
Bamboo counting-sticks laid out to tally the cost: raise funds.
A woven bamboo trunk with a lid: a box.

chars.parts: - three jade beads on a string
chars.story: Three jade beads on a string.
A round, jade-like bead: a pearl.
The one whose mouth gives orders: the monarch.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'ruler'. Modern 君 is mostly 君主 'monarch'.

chars.story: A mouth that cuts straight through a problem: a sage.
Tall and fierce as a boar: heroic.
A child left alone like a melon on a vine: lonely.
A bundle left riding on someone else's back: they renege on carrying it.
chars.note: 赖 stands for 賴. 依赖 'depend on' is the commonest word.

chars.story: Shell-money staked on a throw: gamble.
Mouth watering over another's dish: rob.

chars.parts: 厂 cliff + 日 sun + 子 child
chars.story: A cliff so deep it shades sun and child alike: thick.

chars.parts: 厂 cliff + 万 ten thousand
chars.story: A cliff face with a thousand sharp edges: strict, fierce.
A dog barking at the foot of the cliff all day: you are sick of it.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'tire of'. 厭 became 厌.

chars.story: Walking up the hill alongside someone: accompany.

chars.parts: 阝 mound + 降 descend (right half) + 生 grow
chars.story: A mound swelling taller and taller: it swells.
chars.note: 隆重 means a grand occasion.

chars.story: Hair at the back of the body: a tail.
What escapes from the rear of the body: a fart.
chars.note: Often used as a rude interjection.

chars.story: Set them side by side and they are all alike: all.
A plain little table: ordinary.
A hand laying out the rest of the story: narrative.
Leaning on a stool for support: rely on.

groups.title: covering
groups.note: A roof, a lid, a cave.

chars.story: A roof over everything: the universe.
Living in a cave with no strength left over: destitute.
chars.note: 穷 stands for 窮. 贫 is 'poor'; 穷 is worse: 'destitute'.

chars.story: Covered over again and again until it flips: overturn.
chars.note: Often it means plain 'cover': 覆盖.

chars.story: A cut in the earth for a stream: a ditch.
chars.note: Almost only in 深圳 Shenzhen.

chars.parts: 弓 bow + 畺 field boundary + 土 earth
chars.story: Land measured out by a bow-length and a boundary line: borderland.
Black soot pressed into a block of earth: ink.
Rice turned sweet: sugar.
Two stones come together: bump.
A net across the road, you cannot go on: cease.
chars.note: 罢 stands for 罷. 罢了 'that's all' ends a sentence.

chars.story: Straightening up at a tap and bowing: respect.
chars.note: Same shape as his Analects card 'respect'.

chars.parts: 幺 tiny thread + 𠃌 flipped hook
chars.story: A thread flicked back and forth like a magic trick: illusion.

sentences.en: I want a piece of candy.
This sword has a strange history.
I had sore legs the next day.
The lubrication system was poorly designed.
The express train is moving down the track.
Don't touch this with your dirty hands.

sentences.zh: 纵使没有人陪我，我也要去看这部电影。
sentences.en: Even if no one goes with me, I still want to see this movie.

sentences.zh: 这个家庭非常贫穷以至于无法偿还贷款。
sentences.en: The family is too poor to pay back the debts.
